title: Real-Ribasim external-owner equivalence against canonical SWAP5 restricted fixed-weir oracle
purpose: Test the narrow physical ownership substitution before supply, automatic management or signed infiltration are introduced: Ribasim owns the surface-water storage/level and fixed-weir discharge while SWAP contributes only a positive drainage forcing.
nonclaims: Not a full SWAP 4.3.1 surfacewater.f90 equivalence test.
No level-triggered external supply in Q1A.
No production admission or retirement authority.

frozen_mapping.storage_mapping: V_m3 = level_m + 1.0 for 1 m2 constant Basin area; SWAP oracle storage_cm converts as V_m3 = storage_cm * 0.01

comparators: integrated weir discharge inferred from the independent Ribasim mass ledger
rationale_for_tolerance: The mapping and rating are deliberately linear. The only intended trajectory difference is the canonical fixed-weir candidate's implicit end-step rating evaluation versus Ribasim's continuous integration. With dt=1e-4 day and the frozen cases, the expected method difference is orders of magnitude below 1e-8 m or m3; tolerances are frozen before product execution and may not be widened after observing results.
hypotheses: C0 remains below the crest and has zero integrated discharge in both routes.
C1 and C2 discharge in both routes.
Ribasim final level and storage match the canonical F-CI52 oracle within frozen tolerances.
The independently inferred Ribasim discharge volume matches the oracle accepted discharge volume within the frozen tolerance.
Both route ledgers close without assigning surface-water storage to SWAP in the Ribasim route.
failure_rule: Do not tune geometry, duration, rating law, cases or tolerances after observing Ribasim results. Repair only technical harness failures. A physical mismatch outside the frozen envelope is a Q1A falsification and must remain visible.
pass_meaning: Bounded evidence that fixed-weir surface-water state/discharge can be externally owned by real Ribasim for this linear no-supply profile while SWAP remains only the drainage-forcing owner.
fail_meaning: The proposed ownership substitution is not yet qualified even for the narrow fixed-weir no-supply profile.
